shuffleTest.statistic: home win rate among decided games
shuffleTest.reading: a home-field prior is not distinguishable from a coin at this sample
shuffleTest.previousVersion: permuted the outcomes and compared the permuted home-win COUNT with the observed count; that quantity is invariant under permutation, so the test returned p = 1.0000 by construction
shuffleTest.note: This tests OUTCOME randomness, not strategy skill. It demonstrates the machinery the gates use; it is not evidence that any strategy is profitable.

calibrationDemo.note: A constant 55% prior needs at least 20 games in a decile to be scored; with almost all mass in one bin this is a weak calibration test, shown to prove the method runs.

whyNoneCertified: No strategy has 100 settled bets against a stored price. Certifying one would require inventing both the price and the settlement.
